title: Creating NuGet Packages
description: How to pack and publish your own libraries as NuGet packages.

data.text: To create a NuGet package, you need a .csproj with `<PackageId>`, `<Version>`, and `<Authors>` metadata. Then run `dotnet pack` to produce a `.nupkg` file.

data.title: Packing and Publishing
data.code:
dotnet pack -c Release
dotnet nuget push bin/Release/MyAwesomeLib.1.0.0.nupkg --api-key YOUR_KEY --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use `<PackageId>` to set the package name
Publish to nuget.org or a private feed
data.takeaway: Creating and publishing NuGet packages makes your code reusable across projects.
